video.title: How does MCP work? How to use Model Context Protocol Server #mcp

transcript.text: How does MCP actually work? MCP is a
protocol that lets you connect external
data sources with your LLMs via a
dedicated MCP server. So the first step
is to choose an MCP server that you want
to connect with your LLM. For example,
GitHub MCP server. Each MCP server
provides with tools or functions like
create or update file, push files,
etc. To start using this MCP server, you
need to copy this JSON code and put it
in your LLM's config.json. Once the MCP
server is connected, you can view list
of all available tools in your LLM.
